d: Addressing the Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas programme in Gadchiroli, Maharashtra, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says the country has achieved freedom from Naxalism-Maoism. Recalling its impact on tribal communities, he says around 125 districts were affected by Naxalism in 2014, with thousands of people losing their lives. Modi also alleges that previous governments failed to protect the rights of tribal communities in Naxal-affected areas.
